h:
这是一个 2 阶段工作流程，这意味着它从高 CFG 的基本模型开始，以实现强烈的即时依从性，然后切换到蒸馏模型（在特定的西格玛边界，大约 0.95 适合 5-6 个步骤）以获得更快的处理 (CFG 1) 和精细的细节，类似于 WAN 的高/低工作流程。

使用此 lora 进行第二（蒸馏）阶段：
https://civitai.com/models/2401004?modelVersionId=2699601

o.en:
This is a 2-stage workflow which means it starts with the base model at high CFG for strong prompt adherence, then switches to the distilled model (at a specific sigma boundary, around 0.95 works well with 5-6 steps) for faster processing (CFG 1) and fine details, similar to WAN's high/low workflows.

Uses this lora for the 2nd (distilled) stage:
https://civitai.com/models/2401004?modelVersionId=2699601
